title: AI POD subsystem 07 - OpenShift cluster
description:
Stub schema for the OpenShift install spanning mgmt-nodes-ucs (subsystem 05) and workload-nodes-ucs (subsystem 06). Owns role assignment (control-plane / compact / worker), install topology (compact-then-expand), and the operator stack: NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA Network operator, NFD, GPUDirect RDMA / Storage. The 06-nvidia-operators subsystem from the original layout was absorbed here per D17/N3 (NVIDIA operators are deployed via OCP OperatorHub, not as a separate provisioning step).

Replace with the real shape when automation lands; until then, any object is accepted. When fleshed out, this schema cross-references mgmt-nodes-ucs and workload-nodes-ucs by subsystem name (e.g. control_plane.nodes_from: mgmt-nodes-ucs).
